Let \(h\) be the vertical side length of rectangle \(Q\).

1. Rectangle \(P\) has dimensions \(x \times 4\), so
   \[
   P=4x.
   \]

2. The diagonal fold rises \(4\) units, the width of the strip. Since it is at \(45^\circ\), its horizontal run is also \(4\) units. Thus \(Q\) has width \(4\), so
   \[
   Q=4h.
   \]

3. The fold occurs across a \(4\times4\) square of the strip. Hence the original length \(13\) is divided into the horizontal length \(x\), the \(4\)-unit fold section, and the vertical length \(h\):
   \[
   x+4+h=13,
   \]
   so
   \[
   h=9-x.
   \]

4. Using \(P=2Q\),
   \[
   4x=2\bigl(4(9-x)\bigr).
   \]
   Therefore,
   \[
   x=18-2x,\qquad 3x=18,\qquad x=6.
   \]
